summary: Agassi Sports Entertainment Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its newly formed wholly-owned subsidiary, Agassi Sports Licensing LLC, entered a Merchandise License Agreement on October 30, 2026 with Rhino Entertainment LLC, master licensee of Grateful Dead Productions. No ownership stake, per-share price, premium, or closing date is disclosed. The terms grant a worldwide, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to Grateful Dead trademarks and artwork for pickleball/padel equipment, apparel, and hydration products, in exchange for royalties, guaranteed payments, recoupable nonrefundable advances, and annual advertising commitments. Initial term runs through June 30, 2030, with extension rights. This is a routine commercial licensing contract, not a special situation.
